messages:
Professor Elm: Unfortunately, you
won’t be able to progress any farther in Johto for the time being.But the S.S. Aqua can take you to
Kanto.You can continue your quest there
to become the very best Trainer!
Professor Elm: Take this S.S. Ticket.\nYou’ll need it to board the ship.
Professor Elm: The ship departs from\nOlivine Port.\rGood luck in Kanto,\n{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
